import ctypes
import os

# Load the libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the function prototype
# double gsl_cdf_lognormal_Pinv(const double P, const double zeta, const double sigma);
gsl.gsl_cdf_lognormal_Pinv.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double]
gsl.gsl_cdf_lognormal_Pinv.restype = ctypes.c_double

def lognormal_quantile(P, zeta, sigma):
    """Compute the inverse cumulative distribution function for a log-normal distribution."""
    if not (0 < P < 1):
        raise ValueError("P must be in the range (0, 1).")
    if sigma <= 0:
        raise ValueError("sigma must be positive.")
    return gsl.gsl_cdf_lognormal_Pinv(P, zeta, sigma)
